subject: Post-call: AcmeHealth private VPC discovery - next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: AcmeHealth private VPC discovery - next steps

Hi Samir, Jordan — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap & next steps from our discovery so we have alignment: 

Summary of pain & goals:
- Regulatory/data residency: AcmeHealth needs all PHI-derived model outputs to remain in your US-only cloud region and meet SOC 2 + HIPAA-like controls.
- Network constraints: Tight egress policy; only specific outbound endpoints allowed. Primary requirement is a VPC/private deployment (no public internet access from inference hosts).
- Air-gap evaluation: For certain workloads, you asked about an air-gapped on-prem option for isolated batch inference.
- Performance: Target P95 latency <= 200ms for clinical-search style queries; burst capacity around 100 concurrent requesters.

What we agreed on today:
1) Redwood Private (VPC) looks like the right starting point — control plane in your account, inference hosts in private subnets, NAT/proxy only where you permit.
2) We'll validate the allowed outbound endpoints and provide an allowlist of Redwood control-plane and telemetry endpoints (or an offline agent option).
3) We need network diagrams and a list of current IP ranges/egress proxies from your infra team to validate firewall rules.
4) Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com will be copied once we land on high-level T&Cs (Marissa, can you assist with the initial order of magnitude?).

Immediate next steps (owners & target dates):
- Camila: Send VPC checklist + sample network diagram (attached) — by EOD today.
- Samir: Share network diagram and list of allowed egress addresses / proxy details — by Aug 20.
- Marissa: Help scope the commercial path and provide a rough procurement timeline — by Aug 19.
- Camila & Marissa: Propose a technical deep-dive call with your infra/security (30–45m) — propose Wed 8/18 or Thu 8/19.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf (checklist + sample diagram), networking-diagram-placeholder.png

If any of this is off, let me know — otherwise I'll schedule the deep-dive and loop in our solutions engineer for the demo.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: Data residency requirement is US-only. Any control plane communications must be auditable; we'd prefer KMS integration for keys.
- Egress: We run all outbound through a corporate proxy at 10.8.0.1 (we'll send exact proxy hostnames/IPs). For the VPC deployment we cannot allow arbitrary public IP egress from inference hosts.
- Air-gap: The air-gapped ask is for a small subset of ETL/batch flows (non-real-time). We want to see what a fully on-prem package would look like (installer/checklist + HW sizing).

Procurement: I've looped procurement@acmehealth.com on this thread; they'll need the order of magnitude, basic SOW bullets, and expected monthly committed capacity to start a purchase requisition.

I'll get the network diagram and proxy details to you by Thursday 8/19. Wed 8/18 10:00am PT works for the technical deep-dive — Jordan and I will be available.

Samir
Principal Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
AcmeHealth
samir.patel@acmehealth.com
